name: Finance
description: Banks, funds and asset managers. The pay is high, the hours are longer, and a lot of the analyst work is exactly what AI does best.

name: Big Tech
description: Platforms, clouds and product teams. You build the tools everyone uses, and you get to decide what they optimise for.

name: Research (machine learning)
description: Public and academic AI research. Modest salary, real freedom, and conference deadlines that move like weather fronts.

name: Research (economics & health)
description: Health economics and applied social science: models that decide where hospital budgets and public policy go.

name: Consulting
description: Strategy and transformation for big clients. Eighty-slide decks, three countries a week, and a lot of work a model can draft overnight.

name: Diplomacy (AI & climate)
description: International organisations working on AI governance and climate policy. Treaties, translators and a lot of airports.

name: Strategic management
description: Corporate strategy inside big groups: luxury, retail, industry. You decide where the company goes, slowly, in committee.

name: Energy & industry
description: Oil majors, grid operators and renewables developers. The sector that decides most of the century's emissions, from the inside.

name: NGO & social enterprise
description: Impact organisations on a shoestring. You'll be underpaid, overcommitted and very sure of why you get up in the morning.

name: Startup founder
description: Your own company, or a friend's. Equity, vibes and a runway that is always nine months long.

name: Low-tech life

annual.label: Low-tech life (no car, local food, small home)

description: A farm co-op, a workshop, a small life on purpose. Fewer things, slower days, a much lighter footprint.
